title: Performance Video Ad Editor for Ecommerce Brand | AI UGC, Meta Ads, B-Roll, Short-Form Ads
description:
We are looking for a talented video ad editor to join our ecommerce brand team long term.



This is not a basic editing role.



We need someone who understands how to create scroll-stopping video ads for
, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. You should know how to turn raw clips, AI-generated footage, UGC videos, voiceovers, product clips, and b-roll into clean, high-converting ads.



Our brand sells consumer products online, and most of the videos we create are short-form direct response ads. Some videos will look like native UGC. Some will be voiceover with b-roll. Some will use AI UGC created with tools like Seedance 2.0. Some will be clean product-focused ads with captions, hooks, transitions, sound design, and strong pacing.



We are looking for someone creative, reliable, detail-oriented, and able to follow briefs carefully.



You do not need to be a professional media buyer, but you must understand that the goal of every video is not just to look good. The goal is to stop the scroll, hold attention, and make people want to buy.



What You Will Do



You will help us create different types of ecommerce video ads, including:



UGC-style ads from raw footage

AI UGC videos using Seedance 2.0 or similar AI video tools

Voiceover ads with clean b-roll editing

Product demo videos

Problem-solution ads

Testimonial-style ads

Hook variations for Meta and TikTok

Short 6 to 15 second ad variations

Longer 30 to 60 second direct response ads

Fast-paced ad edits with captions, zooms, cuts, overlays, and sound effects

Clean branded edits that match our brand style

Multiple variations for A/B testing



You will also be expected to:



Follow detailed creative briefs

Make revisions based on feedback

Organize files properly

Deliver edits on time

Suggest improvements when you see a better way to make the ad stronger

Understand why some ads perform better than others

Required Skills



You must have experience with:



Editing short-form video ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, DTC brands, or online products

CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or a similar editing tool

Strong pacing for social media ads

Clean captions and text overlays

Hook editing in the first 1 to 3 seconds

B-roll selection and sequencing

AI voiceovers, preferably ElevenLabs or similar tools

Editing for Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reels, and Shorts

Following brand guidelines

Taking feedback and making revisions quickly

AI Video Skills



This is very important.



We are also looking for someone who can help create AI video ads using tools like:



Seedance 2.0

Kling

Runway

HeyGen

ElevenLabs

ChatGPT

CapCut AI tools

Other AI video or voice tools



You do not need to be perfect with every tool, but you must be willing to learn fast.



A big part of this role may include creating AI UGC clips, AI voiceover videos, product b-roll scenes, and clean ad edits from AI-generated footage.



What We Are NOT Looking For



Please do not apply if:



You only know how to add subtitles

You only make basic TikTok edits

You cannot follow detailed instructions

You get upset when asked for revisions

You do not understand ecommerce ads

You cannot meet deadlines

You need someone to tell you every tiny step

You do not have examples of ad-style videos

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for Hair Etc., a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, run a proven script, and book them onto the salon's calendar.



If you're a sales-oriented setter who loves high-volume work, runs scripts the way they were written, and is motivated by performance pay tied to real results — keep reading. If you want a low-pressure customer service job or you like "making the script your own," this won't be a fit.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren LLC, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on Hair Etc., a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You can see the salon directly:



- Google Maps Listing: 

- Instagram: 



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at Hair Etc. handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script word-for-word for the entire call, from greeting to booking. The only time you go off-script is to answer a client's specific question (directions, timing) or collect unique info.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 DMs, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We say "word-for-word" because that's how the role works — but we want to clear up the most common concern people have about that:



"Won't I sound like a robot if I'm reading a script?"



No. Think about the best actors in your favorite movies. They're saying lines someone else wrote. They don't sound robotic because they've rehearsed enough that the words feel natural, and they bring real warmth, tone, and presence to the delivery. THAT'S EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE AFTER. The script is the structure. Your tone, pacing, and warmth are what make it feel human.



We train for this. You'll rehearse, get coached on tonality and pacing, and review your own call recordings until the words feel like yours — even though they're not. The setters who do this best sound like they're having a natural conversation that just happens to follow a proven path.



The script DOES change over time — but only based on data. If something isn't landing in calls, we test a new version, measure the results, and update the script if it works better. What we don't do is let setters freelance individual changes on the fly, because then we can't tell what's working and what's not.



If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll genuinely consider it. We'll A/B test it together. If the data shows it works better, it becomes the newscript. That's the structured way changes happen here.



If that framing works for you, you'll thrive. If "follow a script and let us measure what works" feels suffocating, this role won't be a fit.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



- Advanced English with minimal accent. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- Strong spoken communication — clear voice, confident on calls, doesn't ramble, not soft-spoken.

- Script discipline. You're comfortable running proven scripts word-for-word in mandatory parts of the call. (See the script section above for context on what this actually means day-to-day.)

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Process-oriented. You follow standardized workflows. If you want to change something, you bring a clear, data-backed suggestion to your manager and wait for a decision.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 25 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- Your background is primarily customer service, general VA work, or admin support with no direct sales or appointment setting experience. This role requires proven experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment. Customer service experience alone is not sufficient.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between May 30 – June 7

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren LLC





---

title: $6 Customer Service Representative
description:
ATTENTION CANDIDATES: READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

We recently cut ties with our old third-party BPO partner. We tried to hire those agents directly, but their old BPO contracts blocked them. Now, those disgruntled agents are upset that new hires are taking over their positions. The old BPO is orchestrating "trick calls" and trying to weaponize old, dramatic articles on KSL or Reddit to scare new applicants and spread rumors that we are a scam.



Here is the truth: We have been in business a long time, we have a massive customer base, and we pay our people via verified direct deposit. We are hiring quickly right now simply because we need a lot of staff to handle our actual customers. Just because our hiring process is fast and efficient does not mean it's a scam. If you are qualified, we choose to trust you immediately. Do not join our team if you intend to log into our systems to start or read into drama. We are looking for professional people who want to work with integrity. If that is you, read the technical requirements below and apply.



$6/hr Customer Service Representative

Please login or register as jobseeker to apply for this job.



TYPE OF WORK: Full Time



WAGE / SALARY: $6 per hour (Traditional Direct Deposit to a verifiable bank account only. No Wisely, PayPal, WhatsApp transfers, or third-party money apps).



HOURS PER WEEK: 40



DATE UPDATED: May 15, 2026



JOB OVERVIEW

SEND ME A DIRECT MESSAGE, NOT YOUR AI GENERATED COVER LETTER OPEN HOUSE INTERVIEWS AT 5PM MST TODAY



We’re looking for sharp, empathetic, and quick-thinking Customer Service Representatives to join our Philippine-based remote team. This isn’t a "read from the script" kind of job. You’ll be managing real travel emergencies, helping members maximize their vacations, and earning extra cash through our aggressive performance incentive program.



Note: Onboarding and basic system walkthrough training takes approximately 90 minutes, and yes—you get paid for your training hours!



What You’ll Actually Do:

Be the Travel Hero: Handle inbound calls from international travelers. One minute you’re booking a luxury stay in Orlando, the next you’re investigating complex situations like "DNS" (Do Not Service) tags from old chargebacks, date changes, or manual payment collections.



Manage the Experience: Help members with their Vacation Offer accounts, unlock blocked logins, explain billing (like annual fees), and coordinate "Bouncebacks" (booking remaining stays for members who finished tour presentations).



Earn Extra Surcharges & Incentives: You are not selling new packages; you are booking what they already bought. However, you can easily pull in an extra $5.00 per action by securing hotel/room upgrades through the system, sending out 5-Star Feedback Surveys that mention your name, or generating new verified referral accounts.



What You Need to Bring (Non-Negotiable Technical Prerequisites):

Hardware: A reliable Windows 10+ PC or Laptop. (No Macs, Chromebooks, or Tablets allowed).



Peripherals: A high-quality, noise-canceling USB headset.



Internet Connection: Wired Fiber internet (25 Mbps+). Stability is key when on a live call.



Power Redundancy: A power backup (UPS) and a secondary internet source to work through local outages.



The Vibe & Mindset: Excellent English with a neutral accent. You must be thick-skinned. Our customers can be aggressive and demanding; you must meet their energy with confidence, authority, and control. We do not do call escalations or transfers—you will be fully equipped to resolve the call yourself.



The Schedule: You must be 100% okay with graveyard shifts, weekends, and PH holidays. Our entire network operates strictly on Mountain Daylight Time (MDT).



Software & Tools You Will Master:

You must be a "tab ninja" comfortable moving fluidly between:



Workfolio: Desktop application for timesheet tracking and mandatory activity logging.



Verizon OneTalk Desktop App: Our mandatory software phone system. (Requires configuring a US region setting for activation).



Zoho CRM (
): Central database for profiles, tracking Lead IDs, and triggering automated
s.



VOC Portal (
): Vacation Offer Central, used for real-time room availability and inventory searches.



VSF Portal: Proprietary internal tool utilized for secure manual payment processing and deposit management.



Google Workspace & Gemini: For team communication via Google Chat, huddles on Google Meet, and using Gemini Advanced Pro (provided by us) as your live destination research assistant.



Why Join Us?

Real Support: We do daily morning and EOD "huddles" via Google Meet. You’re never left on an island; your leads and peers are always a public chat thread away to help with tough cases.



High Earnings Potential: Between the $6.00 base pay and the $5.00 uncapped upgrades/referral incentives, your check can grow very quickly if you are proactive.



Fully Remote: Save the commute and work from your home office anywhere in the Philippines.



Ready to help people see the world and control your own earning potential? 

Apply now and let’s get you to the next Huddle!

Long-term, this position has potential to evolve into a client-facing or leadership role as the business grows.



Key Responsibilities:



Financial Operations & Reporting

*Manage day-to-day accounting activities in QuickBooks

*Reconcile accounts and support month-end/year-end closings

*Oversee invoicing, payments, payroll entries, and expense workflows

(1) Location & Utilities: Where in the Philippines are you currently located? How often have you experienced power or internet outages in the past year? Do you have backup solutions (e.g., generator, mobile hotspot) to ensure your work is not affected?



(2) Home Setup: Will you be working from home? Is your workspace quiet and suitable for handling calls? Do you have your own computer or laptop? Please attach a screenshot of your current internet speed.

Your tone should be calm, polite, and professional.



(7) Current Job: Do you currently have another job? If yes, where, how many hours per week, and what are your roles and tasks in that job?



(8) Schedule, Pay & Start Date: Are you able to work seven days a week, six hours per day, during Central Standard Time (CST) hours without conflicts? What is your expected hourly or monthly rate? What is your earliest physical start date if hired?

 Reels or similar platforms? Please describe your skills and provide samples of your previous work if available.



(10) Fit, Skills & Experience: Briefly introduce yourself and explain why you would be a good fit for this role. Include what you believe is most important when handling spa clients over the phone, especially during complaints, and what other skills or areas you have a lot of experience in.

YouTube Shorts


Skool

Canva

CapCut

ManyChat or similar DM automation tools

ntum.

Writing captions and hooks

CapCut editing

Repurposing content

Basic social media strategy

Paying attention to details

Personal brands

YouTube Shorts

DM automation

Lead magnets and funnel support

We're a fast-growing ecommerce brand looking for a sharp, creative video editor who doesn't just cut clips — they tell stories, speak multiple languages, and know how to use AI tools to work smarter. You'll be a core part of our content engine, producing polished product videos, ads, and multilingual content that converts across EU markets.

If you get excited about combining great storytelling with tools like ElevenLabs and Canva, know your way around a subtitle track, and can adapt content for French, German, Spanish, Dutch and beyond — we want to hear from you.



What you'll do



Edit compelling video content — product videos, ads, and reels — with a strong sense of pacing, story, and visual flow

Adapt and translate video content into multiple EU languages (FR, DE, ES, NL, IT and more), including flawless subtitle creation and voiceover coordination

Duplicate and repurpose creative assets — resizing, reformatting, and localising visuals across formats and platforms using tools like Canva

Use AI tools — especially ElevenLabs — to generate, clone, or translate voiceovers at scale without losing quality or brand voice

Produce perfectly timed, styled, and accurate subtitles that feel native to each language

Collaborate with our broader ecom team on campaigns, product launches, and ad testing





Skills we're looking for



Solid video editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar — you understand why a cut works, not just how

Hands-on experience with Canva for asset creation, resizing, and localisation of visual content

Proficiency with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools to produce natural-sounding multilingual voiceovers

Experience with AI tools broadly — ChatGPT, Runway, Midjourney, or whatever helps you work faster and smarter

Ability to write or review subtitles in at least 2 EU languages, with attention to timing, line breaks, and readability

Strong asset adaptation skills — taking one piece of content and spinning it across multiple languages, formats, and platforms

An ecommerce mindset — you know what converts and edit with that goal in mind

Comfortable with fast turnarounds and working independently within a remote team





What we offer



Competitive salary based on experience

Fully flexible working hours — work when you're at your best

Remote-first setup

Real room to grow within a full ecommerce team

Access to the latest AI tools and subscriptions

Creative freedom and direct input on the content direction





How to apply

Send us your portfolio or showreel, a short intro about yourself, and examples of any multilingual or AI-assisted content you've created. Ecommerce experience is a big plus.

One small thing — to show us you've read this properly, please mention your favourite type of sausage somewhere in your application. It's our little filter. No sausage, no reply.

title: Xero Forensics & Cleanup Expert - Fix Messy Books
description:
This is a hands-on Xero rescue role: you’ll walk into messy, behind-the-scenes accounting, diagnose what’s broken, and deliver clean, report-ready books quickly — with minimal hand-holding. This is for a calm expert who owns outcomes, not an entry-level data-entry role.



What this role will actually involve

- Triage messy Xero files and produce a prioritized remediation plan within the first week.

- Bring bank/credit card/loan accounts up to date — reconcile overdue periods and clear unexplained variances.

- Categorize and reclassify large volumes of uncoded or mis-coded transactions so P&L & balance sheet make sense.

- Locate and remove duplicates; recreate or correct missing entries with supporting documentation.

- Rationalize and clean the Chart of Accounts so reporting is meaningful and month-ends are reliable.

- Fix payroll liability, GST/VAT, and supplier/AP mismatches until accounts tie out.

- Stabilize files from incomplete handovers and document all assumptions, adjustments, and unresolved items.

- Produce concise remediation notes: what you found, exactly what you fixed, remaining risks, and what you need to finish.

- Implement practical controls or process changes to prevent reoccurrence (lightweight, actionable).

- Prepare books and supporting notes so an accountant can pick up clean, auditable months.



What I need from the right person

- Deep, practical Xero expertise (bank rules, repeating journals, reconciliation tools, tracking categories, manual journals).

- Proven track record of catch-up and cleanup work on messy historical books.

- Fast diagnostic ability: quickly form a prioritized plan and execute with minimal oversight.

- Ownership mentality: you deliver the outcome and clearly communicate status and blockers.

- Commercial judgement — you know which fixes matter for reporting and cash decisions.

- Clear, blunt, useful communication: say what’s broken, what you fixed, and what still needs attention.

- Comfortable making documented judgement calls when records are incomplete.

- Organized, rapid, and not fazed by chaos.



Examples of messy situations you’ll fix

- Bank unreconciled for 6+ months with missing bank statements.

- Hundreds of uncoded transactions after a payments-processor migration.

- Duplicated supplier payments and missing invoices.

- Bloated Chart of Accounts with legacy/duplicate codes.

- Payroll liabilities not matching reported balances.



Success in this role (30/60/90)

- 30 days: Triage complete, priority plan in place, high-risk reconciliations started.

- 60 days: Major accounts reconciled, COA rationalized, most catch-up months closed.

- 90 days: Recent months report-ready, cleanup documented, repeatable month-end routine established, and simple controls implemented.



Final note

Tell the truth quickly — I prefer blunt clarity over vague status updates. If you can own messy Xero files and deliver clean, usable books, apply.

title: Game Sound Artist / Sound Designer for Browser Games (SFX + Background Music)
description:

This role focuses on creating engaging game audio, including button sounds, win sounds, reel sounds, bonus sounds, background music, transitions, and other audio elements that make gameplay feel more exciting and polished.



Experience with slot games, casino games, casual games, or arcade games is strongly preferred.



We also prefer artists who actively use AI tools to speed up sound creation, editing, testing, and iteration.

• Create custom sound effects for browser-based games

• Design sounds for buttons, spins, wins, bonuses, reels, cards, wheels, popups, transitions, and UI interactions

• Create audio that matches the style, theme, and emotion of each game

• Produce different sound variations for small wins, medium wins, big wins, jackpot-style moments, and bonus events

• Create smooth audio transitions for gameplay events



Background Music

• Create loopable background music for games

• Produce theme-based music for slot games, arcade games, casino games, and casual games

• Create intro, outro, bonus round, free spin, and special event music when needed

• Use AI tools to accelerate sound design, music generation, editing, and iteration



Requirements



• Strong experience in game sound design

• Ability to create both sound effects and background music

• Experience creating audio for games, apps, or interactive products

• Good understanding of timing, rhythm, emotion, and gameplay feedback

• Able to create loopable music and clean short sound effects

• Experience preparing audio assets for browser/mobile games

• Strong attention to detail in volume balance, audio quality, and timing

• Able to work independently and follow creative direction

• Must overlap with CET working hours



Bonus Skills



• Experience with slot games, casino games, card games, or casual games

• Experience creating sounds for reels, spins, wins, free spins, bonus rounds, jackpots, and UI buttons

• Familiarity with casino-style audio pacing and reward sounds

• Experience using AI tools for audio creation or editing

• Experience with tools such as FL Studio, Ableton, Logic Pro, Reaper, Audition, Audacity, Suno, Udio, ElevenLabs, Stable Audio, or similar

• Basic understanding of how game sounds are triggered inside browser games

• Experience creating audio packs for multiple games or game themes



Location



Remote role open to candidates based in the Philippines, with CET overlap.



How to Apply



Submissions missing requirements will be declined.

description:
Full-Time | Remote | Fashion E-commerce



About us



BJ-ECOM is a growing e-commerce company with a team of 30+ people working across marketing, operations, product, customer support, and development.



We operate multiple Shopify stores in Europe, the United States, and other international markets. Most of our stores are in fashion, and we are currently expanding the way we build and improve our Shopify themes across a large portfolio of brands.



We are looking for a full-time Shopify Store Builder & Theme Designer who can do more than basic Shopify editing.



We need someone who can build complete stores, customize themes properly, make strong design decisions, and create storefronts that feel clean, modern, trustworthy, and easy to shop from.



This role is a mix of store building, theme design, UX thinking, and structured execution.



What You’ll Work On



You will help us build and improve Shopify stores for different fashion brands and markets.



Your work will include setting up new stores, customizing Shopify themes, improving layouts, adapting designs for different brand identities, and making sure each store looks professional on both desktop and mobile.



You will also help us create reusable structures so we can build faster without making every store look the same.



The goal is not to copy and paste one design across every brand. We want a strong system, but each store still needs its own identity.



Responsibilities



Build 3–5 Shopify stores or theme builds per week



Customize Shopify Theme Store themes and high-quality third-party themes



Create clean, modern, mobile-first storefronts



Build homepages, collection pages, product pages, navigation, and basic store structure



Improve spacing, typography, layout flow, and overall visual hierarchy



Adapt themes for different fashion brands, countries, and languages



Keep the Shopify backend clean and organized



Follow internal systems and SOPs



Make sure stores are structured in a way that is suitable for

Google Merchant Center



Work independently and communicate clearly about progress or blockers



What We’re Looking For



3+ years of experience building or designing Shopify stores



Strong experience with Shopify theme customization



Experience with fashion e-commerce stores



A portfolio with Shopify stores you personally worked on



Good eye for layout, spacing, typography, and brand feel



Understanding of mobile-first design and e-commerce UX



Ability to work quickly without making messy stores



Comfortable working with clear systems and repeatable structures



Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to take ownership

Long-term availability



Experience working with multiple countries or languages is a plus.



This Role Is Not a Fit If



You only know how to drag and drop sections

You cannot show stores you personally built or designed

You have no fashion e-commerce experience

You depend on constant step-by-step instructions

You build stores without thinking about UX or conversion

You are only looking for short-term freelance projects



What We Offer



Full-time remote position



Long-term work with a growing e-commerce company



Stable flow of Shopify projects



Clear internal systems and workflows



Direct communication with experienced e-commerce operators



Opportunity to work on many international fashion stores



A role with real ownership and responsibility



Several people on our team have been with us for 4–5 years, so we are looking for someone who also wants to build something long-term with us.



Store Style We Like



The style we usually aim for is clean, fashion-focused, easy to navigate, and conversion-oriented.



Examples of the direction we like:











To apply, please send:



Shopify fashion stores you personally built or designed

A short explanation of what you did in each store

Themes you built or heavily customized

Your Shopify experience level

Your availability to start

Your expected monthly salary

Your preferred working hours or time zone

Any Shopify apps, tools, or themes you commonly work with

Applications without Shopify store examples will not be considered.



We are looking to hire immediately.

title: Paid Media Specialist — Google & Microsoft Ads
description:
Summary

We are a US-based digital marketing and revenue operations agency. Our anchor client spends approximately $1 million per year on Google and Microsoft Ads across e-commerce and B2B quote-to-close channels. The account spans Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Demand Gen campaigns across two branded storefronts, with conversion tracking tied into Salesforce, GA4, and Google Tag Manager. This is real money with real complexity.



We just completed a comprehensive audit that identified over $300K in addressable waste, broken conversion infrastructure, and untapped growth levers. We need a Paid Media Specialist to help execute the optimization roadmap, manage day-to-day campaign operations, and grow into owning account strategy over time. You will work directly with the founder on priorities, analysis, and approvals.



This role starts part-time (10–25 hours/week) and has a clear path to full-time as additional client accounts come under management. We are building a paid media function, not filling a one-off project.



If you have managed significant ad spend, can think in terms of ROAS and unit economics rather than just clicks and impressions, and want a role where your work directly moves revenue, this is built for you.



How This Role Evolves



Phase 1: Execute & Learn (0–90 Days)

You will implement optimizations from a detailed audit roadmap the founder has already built. This includes building out negative keyword lists, suppressing zero-conversion products, adjusting device and geographic bids, fixing ad copy, restructuring ad groups, and cleaning up conversion tracking. Before executing any change, you present your analysis and get founder approval. This phase is about proving your judgment and attention to detail on a live, high-spend account.



Phase 2: Own Day-to-Day Management (90–180 Days)

Once you have demonstrated reliability and analytical rigor, you take over daily campaign monitoring, budget pacing, bid management, search term reviews, and performance reporting. You still bring strategic recommendations to the founder for approval, but you are running the account operations independently. You begin identifying optimization opportunities on your own rather than working exclusively from a provided roadmap.



Phase 3: Own Strategy (180+ Days)

You own the paid media strategy across client accounts. You lead audit-to-roadmap cycles for new clients, propose campaign restructures, recommend budget allocation shifts, and drive testing agendas. The founder reviews and approves strategic decisions, but you are the subject matter expert driving the work. Additional client accounts are added to your portfolio as the agency grows.



What You Will Do

Campaign Management & Optimization

— Manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and Demand Gen

— Manage Microsoft Ads campaigns with increasing scope as accounts are onboarded

— Build, maintain, and expand negative keyword lists (from ~100 to 500–2,000+ per account)

— Perform weekly search term analysis to identify waste, close variant bleed, and new keyword opportunities

— Suppress zero-conversion products in Shopping feeds and optimize product-level bids

— Execute device, geographic, audience, and ad schedule bid adjustments backed by data

— Consolidate RSA ad copy, remove outdated messaging, and test new creative variations

— Manage cross-brand and cross-campaign overlap to prevent self-competition on shared terms

Conversion Tracking & Measurement

— Monitor and troubleshoot conversion tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, and CRM integrations (Salesforce)

— Ensure GCLID, GBRAID, and WBRAID parameters are capturing properly across all web forms

— Validate that conversion actions are active, correctly attributed, and properly categorized (Primary vs. Secondary)

— Track Enhanced Conversions, Customer Match audiences, and offline conversion imports for data quality

— Implement and maintain call tracking (Dynamic Number Insertion) and form submission tracking

Analysis & Reporting

— Produce regular performance reports covering spend, ROAS, conversion volume, cost-per-conversion, and impression share

— Analyze campaign, ad group, keyword, product, landing page, device, and geographic performance to surface actionable insights

— Document analysis and recommendations in writing before presenting to the founder for approval

— Monitor competitive metrics (impression share, overlap rate, outranking share) and flag shifts

— Identify landing page quality gaps and coordinate with the team on page-level improvements

Account Growth & Expansion

— Support Performance Max campaign reactivation and testing with proper asset groups and conversion signals

— Build and manage remarketing and audience strategies across Google and Microsoft

— Identify impression share expansion opportunities and model incremental revenue impact

— Assist with onboarding new client accounts into the paid media workflow as the agency grows



What This Role Is Not

— Not an SEO, social media, or content marketing role

— Not a general virtual assistant or admin role

— Not client-facing account management (founder handles client communication)

— Not a graphic design or landing page development role

— Not an autonomous role on day one — you earn expanded ownership through demonstrated performance



How We Work: The Approval Model

This is important to understand before you apply. We manage significant client ad spend, and every dollar matters. Our workflow operates on an analysis-first, approval-before-execution model:



— Identify — You find the issue or opportunity in the data (waste, underperformance, untapped keyword, bid gap, etc.)

— Analyze — You quantify the impact, pull the supporting data, and document your reasoning

— Recommend — You present the recommendation to the founder with the evidence that supports it

— Execute — After approval, you implement the change and track the result



Routine maintenance tasks (search term negatives, bid adjustments within established guardrails, ad copy fixes) will have pre-approved parameters you can act on independently. Structural changes — campaign restructures, budget shifts, new campaign launches, conversion action changes — always require approval. This workflow is designed to protect the client and build mutual trust. Candidates who find this restrictive are not the right fit. Candidates who recognize this as a structured path to full ownership are.



Tools You Will Use

You must be proficient in the core paid media toolset. Training provided for agency-specific workflows and internal tools.



— Google Ads — Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen (required)

— Microsoft Ads (required)

— Google Analytics 4 / GA4 (required)

— Google Tag Manager (required)

— Google Merchant Center (required)

— Google Sheets / Docs / Drive (required)

— Google Ads Editor + Microsoft Ads Editor (strongly preferred)

— Salesforce or equivalent CRM (familiarity preferred — for conversion pipeline understanding)

— Slack (daily communication)

— Asana (task management tool familiarity — Asana preferred)



Must-Haves

— Minimum 2 years managing Google Ads accounts with significant monthly spend ($10K+/month, higher preferred)

— Hands-on experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaign types

— Strong understanding of conversion tracking: Google Tag, GA4 events, GCLID attribution, Enhanced Conversions, and offline conversion imports

— Experience building and maintaining negative keyword strategies at scale

— Ability to analyze campaign data at the keyword, product, ad group, device, geographic, and landing page level and draw actionable conclusions

— Experience with Google Ads Editor for bulk changes

— Working knowledge of Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization

— Microsoft Ads experience (campaign management, import from Google, UET tracking)

— Strong analytical skills — you think in ROAS, CPA, and margin, not just clicks and CTR

— Ability to write clear analysis summaries and document recommendations before execution

— Strong written English — you will present findings and recommendations in writing regularly

— Available Monday–Friday with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–1 PM

— Detail-oriented and process-driven — mistakes on a $1M account are expensive

— Reliable internet connection with a backup plan



Nice-to-Haves (Not Required, But You Will Stand Out)

— Experience managing $50K+/month in ad spend across Google and Microsoft

— Experience with B2B lead generation campaigns (not just e-commerce)

— Familiarity with Salesforce conversion pipelines and offline conversion tracking

— Experience with Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) for call tracking

— Google Ads certification (Search, Shopping, or Measurement)

— Experience managing multi-brand or multi-storefront accounts with cross-campaign coordination

— Familiarity with landing page testing and CRO principles

— Background in agency environments managing paid media across multiple client accounts

— Experience with auction insights analysis and competitive share-of-voice reporting



Hours & Working Style

— Starts part-time: 15–25 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time as you take on day-to-day management and additional client accounts

— Long-term engagement — we are building a paid media function inside a growing agency

— Consistent daily availability required — ad accounts need monitoring, not sporadic large blocks

— At least 3–4 hours daily overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–1 PM for real-time collaboration and approvals

— Clear, proactive communication is non-negotiable — if something looks wrong in the data, flag it immediately

— You will work alongside the founder (strategy, client relationships, approvals) and coordinate with our SEO and execution teams on cross-channel priorities



What We Offer

We treat contractors like tea
mbers. After a 90-day evaluation period, you become eligible for the following perks:



— Prorated 13th Month Payment — Paid in December or at year-end close, prorated based on months actively engaged after eligibility.

— Paid Time Off — 40 hours (5 days) of PTO upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation period. After one full year of engagement, this increases to 80 hours (10 days) annually.

— Sick / Emergency Time — Reasonable notice required. Specific terms defined during onboarding.

— Remote Work Allowance — $25 to $50 USD/month to support your internet, power, and workspace costs. Exact amount confirmed in writing based on performance and continued engagement.

— Recognized Holidays — Blended Philippine and US holiday calendar agreed upon during onboarding.

— Performance Bonus — Discretionary and based on quality, reliability, output, client impact, and role-specific KPIs.

— Full-Time Conversion — Strong performers during the evaluation period will be offered a transition to full-time hours with expanded scope and additional client accounts.



90-Day Evaluation Period: The first 90 days are a mutual evaluation period. During this time, we assess reliability, analytical quality, turnaround time, communication, attention to detail, and ability to work within our approval workflow. Contractor perks and full-time consideration begin after successful completion of this period.



How to Apply

Please start your proposal with the word ROAS so we know you read the full post.



In your proposal, please answer the following:



1. You open a Google Ads account and see that Performance Max campaigns are spending 40% of budget at a 1.85x blended ROAS, but the top 5 campaigns averaged 2.77x while the bottom 4 averaged 0.55x. All PMax campaigns were paused by a previous manager. What is your approach?

2. An e-commerce account has only 117 negative keywords and you find $131K in spend on 3,100+ search terms with zero conversions. Walk us through how you would prioritize and build the negative keyword list.

3. Are you comfortable in a role where you present analysis and recommendations to the founder for approval before making changes, especially in the first 90–180 days?



If you have case studies, audit samples, or screenshots showing Google Ads performance improvements you contributed to, please include them. We are especially interested in seeing how you think through account problems, not just before-and-after numbers.

title: WordPress Developer — Elementor
description:
Summary

We are a US-based digital marketing agency that builds and manages WordPress websites for professional services clients across legal, e-commerce, healthcare, travel, landscaping, retail, and nonprofit. We currently manage seven active client sites and are growing. Every site runs on WordPress with Elementor as the primary page builder.



We need a WordPress Developer who can build and ship client-facing websites and pages at agency pace. Our current bottleneck is web development speed — projects that should take weeks are taking months. If you can take a wireframe, a brand direction, and a set of page requirements and turn them into a polished, mobile-responsive, fast-loading WordPress site using Elementor without constant hand-holding, this role is for you.



This role starts part-time (15–30 hours/week) and has a clear path to full-time as the client portfolio grows. There is no shortage of work — we need someone who can keep up with it.



A portfolio is required. Proposals without links to live WordPress sites you have built will not be considered.



What Agency Pace Means

We want to be direct about this because it is the reason this role exists. In an agency environment, web development moves on client timelines, not open-ended project timelines. Here is what we consider normal throughput for this role:



— A full client website (5–10 pages, standard service business) should move from approved wireframe to staging review in 2–3 weeks, not 2–3 months

— A single landing page or interior page build should take hours, not days

— Page revisions based on feedback should be turned around within 24–48 hours

— You should be able to manage 2–3 active projects simultaneously without losing quality or missing deadlines



If you are someone who needs weeks to build a single page or frequently misses deadlines, this is not the right fit. If you are fast, organized, and take pride in shipping clean work on schedule, you will do very well here.



What You Will Do

Website Builds & Page Development

— Build complete client websites in WordPress using Elementor Theme Builder from wireframes, mockups, or detailed page briefs provided by the founder

— Create and customize page templates, headers, footers, archive pages, single post templates, and dynamic content layouts in Elementor

— Build service pages, landing pages, blog layouts, contact pages, about pages, team pages, and other standard business site pages

— Implement mobile-responsive design across all breakpoints — every page must look clean on desktop, tablet, and mobile

— Build on staging environments and push to production after founder review and approval

WordPress Administration & Plugin Management

— Install, configure, and troubleshoot WordPress plugins including forms (Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7), SEO (Rank Math), caching, security, and image optimization (Imagify)

— Manage WordPress updates (core, theme, plugins) and resolve conflicts or issues that arise from updates

— Configure domain connections, SSL, hosting environment settings, and DNS as needed

— Set up and maintain staging environments for safe development and testing

— Troubleshoot site issues — broken layouts, plugin conflicts, slow load times, form errors, 404s — and resolve them without being asked twice

Performance & Quality

— Optimize page speed and Core Web Vitals — compress images, minimize CSS/JS, configure caching, and lazy-load media

— Ensure cross-browser compatibility (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge)

— Implement basic on-page SEO structure as directed (heading hierarchy, alt text, meta fields via Rank Math)

— Follow brand guidelines for each client — correct fonts, colors, spacing, and imagery across all pages

— QA every page before submitting for review — check links, forms, responsive breakpoints, and load times

Collaboration & Process

— Work from clear briefs and wireframes provided by the founder — ask clarifying questions early, not after building the wrong thing

— Provide time estimates for each build and communicate proactively if timelines shift

— Document reusable templates, section libraries, and build patterns so the team can scale

— Coordinate with the content and SEO teams when builds require content integration or technical SEO implementation



What This Role Is Not

— Not a design role — you will receive wireframes, mockups, and brand direction; you are not creating concepts from scratch

— Not an SEO strategist, content writer, or marketing role

— Not a custom PHP developer or theme coder — we build with Elementor, not custom code (though basic CSS/HTML for adjustments is expected)

— Not a general virtual assistant or admin role

— Not client-facing — the founder handles all client communication



Tools You Will Use

You must be highly proficient in WordPress and Elementor. Training provided for agency-specific workflows only.



— WordPress (required — this is the entire job)

— Elementor Pro / Elementor Theme Builder (required — non-negotiable)

— Rank Math (required — for on-page SEO field entry)

— Gravity Forms, WPForms, or Contact Form 7 (required)

— Imagify or ShortPixel (image optimization)

— WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, or equivalent caching plugin

— Google PageSpeed Insights / GTmetrix (performance testing)

— Canva (basic asset resizing and formatting — not design work)

— Google Drive / Docs / Sheets (file and brief management)

— Slack (daily communication)

— Asana (task management tool familiarity — Asana Preferred)

— Staging environments (Bluehost, WP Engine, or equivalent — familiarity required)



Must-Haves

— Portfolio required — you must include links to live WordPress sites you have built or significantly contributed to. Proposals without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

— Minimum 2 years building WordPress websites using Elementor (not just minor edits — full site builds)

— Strong proficiency with Elementor Theme Builder including custom headers, footers, archive templates, and dynamic content

— Demonstrated ability to build a complete business website (5–10 pages) from wireframe to staging in 2–3 weeks

— Experience managing multiple WordPress plugins and resolving plugin conflicts

— Mobile-responsive design skills — your sites must look polished on every device

— Page speed optimization experience — you know how to get pages loading fast without sacrificing quality

— Comfortable working in staging environments and following a staging-to-production deployment workflow

— Basic CSS and HTML for fine-tuning layouts, spacing, and responsive adjustments beyond what Elementor handles natively

— Experience working across multiple client websites simultaneously without mixing up branding, assets, or instructions

— Strong written English — clear communication on timelines, blockers, and questions is essential

— Available Monday–Friday with at least 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM

— Reliable internet connection with a backup plan



Nice-to-Haves (Not Required, But You Will Stand Out)

— Experience building sites for professional services clients (law firms, healthcare, B2B companies)

— Familiarity with WooCommerce setup and product page builds

— Experience with Elementor custom code widgets or Elementor Pro integrations

— Background in an agency environment building sites for multiple clients on rotation

— Experience with Google Tag Manager container installation and basic conversion tracking setup

— Familiarity with accessibility basics (WCAG compliance, ADA considerations)

— Experience with domain migration, site cloning, or hosting transfers

— Familiarity with Bluehost or WP Engine hosting environments



Hours & Working Style

— Starts part-time: 15–30 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time as the client portfolio grows and build volume increases

— Long-term engagement — we have a growing pipeline of client sites that need building and ongoing maintenance

— Consistent daily availability preferred — web builds move in sprints and require steady progress, not sporadic blocks

— At least 3 hours daily overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM for feedback loops and approvals

— You will receive detailed briefs and wireframes — your job is to build fast, build clean, and flag blockers early

— You will work alongside the founder (creative direction, client communication, approvals) and coordinate with our content and SEO teams on site launches



What We Offer

We treat contractors like tea
mbers. After a 90-day evaluation period, you become eligible for the following perks:



— Prorated 13th Month Payment — Paid in December or at year-end close, prorated based on months actively engaged after eligibility.

— Paid Time Off — 40 hours (5 days) of PTO upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation period. After one full year of engagement, this increases to 80 hours (10 days) annually.

— Sick / Emergency Time — Reasonable notice required. Specific terms defined during onboarding.

— Remote Work Allowance — $25 to $50 USD/month to support your internet, power, and workspace costs. Exact amount confirmed in writing based on performance and continued engagement.

— Recognized Holidays — Blended Philippine and US holiday calendar agreed upon during onboarding.

— Performance Bonus — Discretionary and based on quality, reliability, build speed, and client impact.

— Full-Time Conversion — Strong performers during the evaluation period will be offered a transition to full-time hours with expanded responsibilities.



90-Day Evaluation Period: The first 90 days are a mutual evaluation period. During this time, we assess build quality, speed, communication, attention to detail, mobile responsiveness, and ability to manage multiple projects. Contractor perks and full-time consideration begin after successful completion of this period.



How to Apply

Please start your proposal with the word BUILD so we know you read the full post.



In your proposal, please include the following:



1. Links to 2–3 live WordPress sites you built using Elementor. For each, briefly describe your role (full build vs. specific pages), the timeline from start to launch, and any plugins you integrated. This is mandatory — proposals without portfolio links will not be reviewed.

2. A client needs a 7-page professional services website (Home, About, 3 Service pages, Blog, Contact) with a custom header/footer, mobile responsiveness, contact form integration, and basic SEO fields populated. You receive the wireframe and brand assets on day one. How long does it take you to deliver a staging-ready build, and what does your process look like?

3. Are you comfortable working on multiple client sites simultaneously where strategy and creative direction come from the founder, and your focus is building fast and building clean?

OTE: ~$3,000-$8,000+ USD per year (depending on volume and speed)

ABOUT US

Speed of execution

title: Bookkeeper / Staff Accountant — US CPA Firm (QBO)
description:
Not at all. Here's the updated version with the supervision language added and the title-related tweaks reflected:



We are a small, established CPA firm in Springfield, Missouri (USA) looking for ONE dedicated, experienced bookkeeper to handle bookkeeping for our small business clients. This is a direct-hire role — you work for me, not a staffing agency. One client, one boss, full accountability.

All work is reviewed by a CPA before delivery to the client. You will have support and feedback, not pressure to be the final word.

This is NOT a bank-feed matching role. We need someone who actually understands accounting and can think.

The Role

You will handle day-to-day bookkeeping for multiple small business clients (restaurants, construction, professional services, water districts). Specifically:



Enter and pay bills in QuickBooks Online (and occasionally QuickBooks Desktop — 90/10 split favoring Online)

Reconcile bank accounts monthly

Review the General Ledger for client mispostings and propose corrective reclassifications

Identify when something coded as an expense should be a fixed asset (and vice versa)

Maintain Fixed Asset listings — add new assets, retire old ones, record depreciation expense

Properly split loan payments between interest and principal

Print and review Balance Sheet and P&L for obvious errors before submitting for CPA review

Use Excel and Word for supporting workpapers; willingness to use AI tools to improve efficiency



Required (Non-Negotiable)



Strong, current, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience (heavy daily use, not just exposure)

Working knowledge of QuickBooks Desktop

Real accounting education — Bachelor's in Accountancy or equivalent

Solid understanding of debits/credits and US GAAP fundamentals

Ability to look at a GL and spot what's wrong — not just record what the bank tells you

Strong written and spoken English

Reliable internet and a quiet, dedicated workspace

title: Rockstar Facebook Community Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Posting: Rockstar 
munity Virtual Assistant

Company: Comeback Performance

Role: 
munity Virtual Assistant (Remote)

Hours: Part-Time | Flexible Schedule 

Compensation: $10/day for KPI’s hit + $5 per discovery call booked and showed



ABOUT US

Comeback Performance is an online shoulder recovery program dedicated to helping people eliminate shoulder pain, regain full function, and get back to living the life they love. At the heart of our community is the Online Shoulder Comeback Community — a private
 group where our members support one another, share progress, and get guidance from our team.

We are growing fast and looking for a highly organized, people-first Virtual Assistant to help us manage and grow this community with intention and care.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As our 
munity VA, you will be the daily heartbeat of our online community. Your primary mission is to start and nurture real conversations with members and guide people toward booking a free discovery call with our team when the time is right.

This is not a passive moderation role — it requires proactive outreach, consistent follow-up, and a warm, professional communication style.

You will be given scripts, templates, and training to guide your conversations, so prior experience in health or shoulder recovery is not required. What matters most is that you are organized, reliable, people-oriented, and committed to showing up consistently.

You will work closely with our
 Group Admin (Dr. Joseph) and our DM lead to make sure members are supported and no potential lead “falls through the cracks.”



RESPONSIBILITIES

1. New Member Approval

Review and approve (or decline) all pending membership requests at least once per day, ensuring the community remains a high-quality, relevant space for people dealing with shoulder pain and recovery.

2. New Member Outreach & Conversations

Personally reach out via direct message to every new member who joins the community.

Using provided scripts, welcome them, ask about their shoulder situation, and, where appropriate, invite them to book a free discovery call with our team.

Your success will be measured in part by how many new members book and show up to a discovery call as a result of your conversations.

3. Ongoing Member Follow-Up

Maintain a running log of members from previous weeks and follow up with them regularly to check in on their shoulder progress.

Keep conversations going, build rapport, and identify members who may be ready for a discovery call.

4. CRM Navigation & Outreach Management

Use our online CRM (GoHighLevel) to log member interactions and track where each person is in the outreach process.

Update contact records after conversations, mark when a member has been invited to book a discovery call, and flag members who need follow-up.

Work with our sales team by clearly tagging which members booked and showedfor calls as a result of your outreach.

5. Daily Communication with the
 Administrator

Maintain regular communication with the
 Administrator (Dr. Joseph) to stay aligned on priorities, share updates, and flag any member conversations that need his direct attention.

Be open to feedback on scripts and approach so we can continually improve member experience and results.

6. Daily Statistics Report

At the end of each working day, submit a brief written report documenting your activity. This report should include objective metrics such as:

New members welcomed (DMs sent)

Follow-up messages sent (previous-member check-ins)

Posts engaged with (comments on posts)

Comments replied to (member comments responded to)

Membership requests reviewed (approved/declined)

Discovery calls booked and discovery calls that showed from your outreach

CRM records created/updated



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Excellent written English — warm, professional, and conversational

Highly organized with the ability to track many conversations at once

Reliable and self-motivated — you take ownership without needing to be chased

Comfortable working from scripts and adapting them naturally in conversation

Prior experience managing a
 Group or online community is a strong plus

Familiarity with Google Sheets and simple CRMs (or willingness to learn quickly)

Available to check in on the community daily (including weekends) for shorter blocks, not necessarily full workdays



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Full onboarding and training

Conversation scripts and templates for all outreach scenarios

A clear daily task checklist

Direct access to our team for questions, support, and feedback

Performance-based bonuses tied to the number of discovery calls booked and showed from your outreach

 your resume to:

 groups?

.

Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly (subject line,

ABOUT US

Comeback Performance is an online shoulder recovery program dedicated to helping people eliminate shoulder pain, regain full function, and get back to living the life they love. At the heart of our community is the Online Shoulder Comeback Community — a private
 group where our members support one another, share progress, and get guidance from our team.

We are growing fast and looking for a highly organized, people-first Virtual Assistant to help us manage and grow this community with intention and care.



ABOUT THE ROLE

As our 
munity VA, you will be the daily heartbeat of our online community. Your primary mission is to start and nurture real conversations with members and guide people toward booking a free discovery call with our team when the time is right.

This is not a passive moderation role — it requires proactive outreach, consistent follow-up, and a warm, professional communication style.

You will be given scripts, templates, and training to guide your conversations, so prior experience in health or shoulder recovery is not required. What matters most is that you are organized, reliable, people-oriented, and committed to showing up consistently.

You will work closely with our
 Group Admin (Dr. Joseph) and our DM lead to make sure members are supported and no potential lead “falls through the cracks.”



RESPONSIBILITIES

1. New Member Approval

Review and approve (or decline) all pending membership requests at least once per day, ensuring the community remains a high-quality, relevant space for people dealing with shoulder pain and recovery.

2. New Member Outreach & Conversations

Personally reach out via direct message to every new member who joins the community.

Using provided scripts, you will welcome them, ask about their shoulder situation, and where appropriate, invite them to book a free discovery call with our team.

Your success will be measured in part by how many new members book and show up to a discovery call as a result of your conversations.

3. Ongoing Member Follow-Up

Maintain a running log of members from previous weeks and follow up with them regularly to check in on their shoulder progress.

Keep conversations going, build rapport, and identify members who may be ready for a discovery call.

4. CRM Navigation & Outreach Management

Use our online CRM (GoHighLevel) to log member interactions and track where each person is in the outreach process.

Update contact records after conversations, mark when a member has been invited to book a discovery call, and flag members who need follow-up.

Work with our sales team by clearly tagging which members booked and showed for calls as a result of your outreach.

5. Daily Communication with the
 Administrator

Maintain regular communication with the
 Administrator (Dr. Joseph) to stay aligned on priorities, share updates, and flag any member conversations that need his direct attention.

Be open to feedback on scripts and approaches so we can continually improve member experience and results.

6. Daily Statistics Report

At the end of each working day, submit a brief written report documenting your activity. This report should include objective metrics such as:

New members welcomed (DMs sent)

Follow-up messages sent (previous-member check-ins)

Posts engaged with (comments/likes)

Comments replied to (member comments responded to)

Membership requests reviewed (approved/declined)

Discovery calls booked and discovery calls that showed from your outreach

CRM records created/updated



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Excellent written English — warm, professional, and conversational

Highly organized with the ability to track many conversations at once

Reliable and self-motivated — you take ownership without needing to be chased

Comfortable working from scripts and adapting them naturally

Prior experience managing a
 Group or online community is a strong plus

Familiarity with Google Sheets and simple CRMs (or willingness to learn quickly)

Available to check in on the community daily (including weekends) for shorter blocks, not necessarily full workdays



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Full onboarding and training

Conversation scripts and templates for all outreach scenarios

A clear daily task checklist

Direct access to our team for questions, support, and feedback

Performance-based bonuses tied to the number of discovery calls booked and showed from your outreach

I send you raw material on a topic (3 to 10 minutes of voice, or 500 to 1500 words of text)

English comfortable enough to digest YouTube and business concepts (audience retention, CTR, RPM, thumbnails, etc.) and ask sharp clarifying questions.



Proactive: when material is unclear or thin, you ask or research instead of guessing.

Background or interest in YouTube content creation

Miro Boards experience

Past work on educational or training content



OFFER
