title: Vibe Coder (Full-Time)
description:
Company Overview

We operate a growing network of YouTube channels in the gardening, homesteading, and lawn care niches. Our operation is powered by a custom-built AI production platform called GardenFlow that automates the entire video production pipeline — from script generation and voiceover synthesis to thumbnail creation and Google Drive delivery. We are a small, fast-moving team that ships daily and treats AI tools as force multipliers, not novelties.

We are looking for a Vibe Coder / Prompt Engineer to join the team full-time and take ownership of building, extending, and maintaining the AI-powered tools and workflows that run this operation.

What You Will Do

Your primary responsibility is building and improving the internal tools that power our YouTube channel network. This is not a traditional software engineering role — you will work almost exclusively through AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, Manus) to ship features, fix bugs, and build new products. The role breaks down into three areas:

Platform Development & Maintenance. You will own the day-to-day development of GardenFlow, our production web application built with React, TypeScript, tRPC, and Tailwind. This includes fixing bugs, shipping new features, improving the UI/UX, and keeping the platform stable as we scale. You will also build and maintain API integrations with third-party services (image/video generation providers, TTS providers, YouTube Data API, Google Drive API).

Analytics & Reporting. You will build a centralized analytics dashboard — an admin panel behind our webstores — that serves as a single pane of glass for the entire operation. On the webstore side, this means tracking revenue, conversion rates, average order value, customer lifetime value, traffic sources, abandoned carts, and funnel drop-off. On the YouTube side, this means pulling in views, click-through rates, watch time, subscriber growth, and revenue per channel. The goal is to give the team real-time visibility into what is working and what is not, without needing to check five different platforms.

New Product Development. As the operation grows, you will help build new consumer-facing products — including ebook webstores with Stripe payments,
 delivery, and A/B testing. Down the line, this may expand to include a consumer mobile app (think PictureThis-style plant identification) and other digital products in the gardening space.

What We Are Looking For

You must be highly proficient with AI coding tools. This means you can take a feature request, break it down, prompt an AI assistant to generate the code, review and debug the output, and ship it — all within hours, not days. You should be comfortable working with React/TypeScript/Node.js codebases even if you did not write every line by hand. You need to understand what the code does, why it works, and how to fix it when it breaks.

You must be a proactive self-starter. This is a small team. Nobody will write you a detailed spec or hold your hand through implementation. You will get a Loom video or a 
 message describing what needs to happen, and you figure out the rest. If something is broken, you investigate before being asked. If you see an opportunity to improve a workflow, you flag it and build it.

You must be chronically online and responsive. This is a remote role, but we move fast. Your core working hours are 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM Manila Time (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM CET), Monday through Saturday. During these hours, you are expected to be actively working and reachable. Outside of core hours (and excluding Sundays), you must be reachable via 
 mobile in case of emergencies — you are the only code person on the team, so if the webapp breaks at an odd hour, you are the one we call. Sundays are fully off. This is not a role where you clock in and clock out — we need someone who genuinely cares about keeping the operation running.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience with any of the following is a plus but not a dealbreaker: building analytics dashboards or working with YouTube Analytics / Google Analytics APIs; Stripe payment integration and e-commerce flows; prompt engineering for image/video generation models; mobile app development (React Native or Flutter); experience with Drizzle ORM, tRPC, or similar TypeScript-first stacks.

Compensation



Base Retainer (Months 1-3): $600 USD / month

Base Retainer (Month 4+): $800 USD / month (based on performance)

Maximum Monthly Earnings: Up to $2,000 USD / month (base + bonuses)

Payment Method: Wise or Binance

Payment Schedule: Monthly, within 10 business days of invoice



What We Provide

All software subscriptions required for the role are covered by us. This includes AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Manus), API credits, and any other SaaS tools needed for the job. You are responsible for your own computer, internet connection, and home office setup.

Contract Details



Type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Term: 12 months initial, auto-renewing annually

Hours: Full-time, flexible schedule within core hours

Core Hours: 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM Manila Time (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM CET), Monday to Saturday

On-Call: Reachable via 
 mobile outside core hours (Mon-Sat) for emergencies. Sundays fully off.

Location: Remote

Start Date: ASAP

Exclusivity: Full dedication required — no side projects, no other work.



How to Apply

Send your application with the following:



Link one project that you built with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, Manus, etc.), and describe what you built, how you built it, how much of it you built, what tools you used, and how long it took you to build it.

Have you used Manus AI before? Simple yes or no.

A link to any portfolio / GitHub profile that demonstrates your ability to ship working software.



Do not send a generic cover letter. We want to see that you actually read this post and understand what the role involves.

title: Elite Android Security Systems Developer
description:
PROJECT: AI Smartphone Anti-Theft / Panic Defense System



Core Vision:

Build a highly aggressive smartphone anti-theft and panic-response system focused on immediate disruption, deterrence, and recovery — not passive background security.



The phone should actively “fight back” and become extremely stressful, risky, and socially unusable for the thief.



Primary Launch Strategy:



* Android first

* Fast execution

* Small elite builder team

* Focus on a “Holy shit, this actually works” MVP



Core Product Philosophy:

Security over convenience.



False positives are preferable to missing a real theft event.



Main MVP Components:



1. Trusted Faces System



* Owner registers trusted faces/users

* Unknown face + suspicious movement/context triggers escalation



2. Panic / Stolen Mode



* Owner can remotely activate stolen mode from any device within seconds after theft



3. Extreme Escalation Layer



* Maximum volume siren

* Flashlight strobe

* Aggressive vibration

* Fullscreen warning mode

* AI multilingual voice alerts:

    “STOLEN DEVICE”

    “OWNER ALERTED”

    “POLICE REPORT INITIATED”

    “FACE RECORDED”

    etc.



4. Exposure / High Security Modes

    Examples:



* Beach mode

* Travel mode

* Restaurant mode

* Tourist/high-risk mode



Very low tolerance for suspicious activity when device is unattended/exposed.



5. Front Camera Capture



* Unknown user face captured automatically

* Stored locally immediately

* Uploaded automatically once any network connection becomes available



6. Tracking System



* Background tracking prepared before theft occurs

* Panic escalation increases tracking aggressiveness



7. SIM / eSIM Tampering Trigger

    If protection is armed and:



* SIM removed

* eSIM modified/deactivated

* network profile manipulated



? immediate escalation.



8. AI Role

    AI is NOT primarily for convenience.



AI is used for:



* context analysis

* suspicious movement detection

* abnormal usage pattern recognition

* aggressive early escalation



Examples:



* unusual movement speed/patterns

* owner separation

* sprint/flucht-like movement

* unknown user behavior

* abnormal unlock/use patterns



Important Technical Direction:



* Android is significantly more flexible than iPhone for MVP development

* Deep OS/hardware control remains one of the hardest technical boundaries

* Device restart from fully powered-off state is difficult/impossible without hardware-level integration



Ideal Developer Profiles:



* Strong Android/mobile systems developers

* Real-time systems mindset

* Sensor/camera/Bluetooth/device API experience

* Security-oriented thinking

* Fast execution builders

* Problem solvers over corporate-style coders



Goal:

Create a system that massively increases:



* stress for the thief

* visibility

* identification probability

* recovery chances

* social/public pressure



while reducing:



* resale attractiveness

* successful escape

* calm operation after theft

title: Senior Finance Operations Lead - Xero, Stripe, CEO Reporting
description:
Trillet is looking for a senior finance operations lead who can help re-architect our finance and accounting setup from first principles.



Expected workload: roughly 20-40 hrs/week during the first 4-8 week architecture and cleanup phase, depending on backlog and fit. After the system is stable, this may settle into 10-20 hrs/week ongoing, with heavier weeks around month-end close, tax/R&D support, or reporting upgrades.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role and not a tax-only role. We need someone who can help turn the finance function into a reliable operating system for weekly CEO/CFO decisions.



The core job is to make the accounting substrate clean enough that it can support management reporting, accountant/controller review, and future BI dashboards.



You will help design and maintain the structure across:



- Xero chart of accounts and tracking categories

- bank/card reconciliation

- Stripe payouts, fees, refunds, failed payments, and subscription/payment activity

- AR visibility and overdue follow-up

- AP and bill workflow support

- month-end close

- revenue and direct-cost classification

- founder / related-party schedules

- weekly CEO/CFO reporting

- monthly accountant/controller support packs



The outcome we need is practical: every week the CEO should be able to trust what he sees on cash, AR, reconciliation status, revenue by type, direct delivery costs, gross-margin signals, Stripe/payment movement, founder balances, and open exceptions.



You should be a systems thinker with accounting depth. The right person can look at messy startup finance, identify what is structurally wrong, ask sharp questions, and design a clean go-forward operating model.



You do not need to be a CFO. You do not need to be a data engineer. But you should understand that Xero is not just for compliance. It is the foundation for management reporting and future BI.



Must have:



- strong Xero experience

- bank/card reconciliation cleanup experience

- month-end close experience

- AR/AP discipline

- chart-of-accounts or tracking-category judgment

- ability to create useful management reporting

- clear written English

- ability to document exceptions instead of forcing bad classifications



Strong bonus:



- Stripe or payment processor reconciliation

- SaaS, startup, subscription, usage-based, or ecommerce finance experience

- multi-currency experience

- customer/project/offer-level margin reporting

- AU/GST/BAS familiarity

- payroll support

- BI, spreadsheet, dashboard, or API literacy



Important boundaries:



- This role does not include payment authority.

- Major accounting structure changes need founder/accountant approval.

- Tax/compliance policy decisions stay with our AU accountant/controller.

- The finance lead prepares, reconciles, documents, recommends, and maintains the operating system.



To apply, please answer these questions directly. Generic applications will be ignored.



1. What is the most complex messy Xero or finance cleanup you have personally handled?

2. How would you think about redesigning a chart of accounts and tracking structure so it supports CEO/CFO reporting?

3. Have you reconciled Stripe, payment processors, ecommerce payouts, refunds, fees, or subscriptions? Please describe exactly what you reconciled.

4. What weekly finance dashboard would you create for a founder/CEO?

5. What would you keep inside Xero, and what would you keep in a reporting/BI layer or external schedule?

6. What AU/GST/BAS/payroll exposure do you have, if any?

7. What is your expected monthly rate in USD, and how many hours per week are you available?



Please only apply if you are comfortable with messy startup finance and can help build a cleaner system, not just process transactions.

title: Phone Appointment Setter - US Battery Backup Program (Not Solar)
description:
About the role



  You're the first voice on the phone for the Texas Grid Resilience Project - a battery-backup and lower-rate energy program for Texas homeowners. You don't sell. You don't quote prices. You don't visit anyone's house. Your one job is to confirm that the person on the phone owns their home, make crystal clear that this is NOT solar (no roof panels, no solar loan, we do not touch the roof), and book them onto a US-based specialist's calendar for a 10-minute follow-up call.



This is appointment setting, not closing. The specialist does the heavy lifting. You get them to the appointment.



What you'll do every shift



  - Work through a queue of pre-loaded Texas homeowner leads in our dialer

  - Follow the script

  - Qualify: homeowner (not renter), on the utility bill, can text a breaker-panel photo, understands this is a phone call and not a home visit

  - Pivot to the appointment by offering two specific time windows, never as a yes/no question

  - Use the rebuttal library inside the live dialer — no improvising on objections

  - Disposition every call cleanly and log notes the QA team can read

  - Roll into weekly QA review knowing every call is recorded and a sample is scored



Compensation



  - Hourly base, paid weekly

  - Appointment commission (held until the appointment is confirmed)

  - Weekly leaderboard with a cash prize for the top performer; bottom of the week is flagged for review



  A strong setter's bonuses meaningfully outpace base. We will give you exact numbers in the interview.



Schedule



  - US Central business hours, mostly afternoons and early evenings

  - Monday through Saturday — we do not call on Sundays

  - Minimum hours/week confirmed at offer



Equipment and workspace



  - Reliable wired internet (no public WiFi, no shared mobile hotspots during shifts)

  - A computer that runs Chrome smoothly

  - Noise-canceling headset with a quality mic

  - A quiet, professional-sounding workspace — no background TV, no kids in the room, no dogs barking. All calls are recorded; ambient

  noise gets flagged.



Who we're hiring



  - Comfortable making outbound calls to US homeowners

  - Clear, friendly English at a pace customers don't have to ask you to repeat

  - Coachable — you'll get QA feedback weekly and you'll act on it

  - Disciplined about the script: the opener, the not-solar disclaimer, and the ownership question are non-negotiable

  - Bonus: experience in energy, home services, insurance, or any phone-based appointment setting



Hard lines — single-strike compliance



  - Saying or implying this is solar

  - Claiming to be from the utility company

  - Guaranteeing savings of any amount

  - Telling the customer they are "approved" before specialist verification

  - Ignoring a do-not-call request



   Cross any of these once and your access is revoked while we review the recording. We don't bend on these.



How hiring works (wave-based)



  1. Short prescreen (US Central availability, outbound experience, equipment check, ownership-question comfort)

  2. Application + voice recording sample

  3. Written test on the rebuttals and the not-solar disclaimer

  4. Compliance agreement

  5. Mock-call evaluation

  6. Paid one-week live trial with QA scoring

  7. Decision: hired, extended, or released



  If "not solar, not solar, not solar" is already echoing in your head, you're ahead of most applicants. Apply.

title: Technical SEO & GEO Specialist
description:
Summary

We are a US-based digital marketing and revenue operations agency that manages SEO, content, and web optimization across a portfolio of seven active clients spanning e-commerce, legal, travel, healthcare, retail, landscaping, and nonprofit.



We are hiring a Technical SEO & GEO Specialist to own organic search performance across this portfolio. You will not be publishing blog posts or scheduling social media. You will be the person who diagnoses why a site is underperforming, builds the optimization roadmap, and directs our execution team on exactly what to fix. You will work directly with the founder — not a middle manager — on strategy, audits, and client priorities.



This role starts part-time (10–20 hours/week) and has a clear path to full-time if performance is strong during the initial evaluation period. We are building a team, not filling a temporary gap.



This role exists because search is changing. AI-driven search experiences are reshaping how businesses get found, and we need someone who understands both traditional technical SEO and generative engine optimization well enough to keep our clients visible as that shift accelerates. If you are tired of execution-only roles and want to own SEO outcomes across a real, revenue-generating client portfolio, this is built for you.



What You Will Own

Technical SEO Strategy & Audits

— Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits for existing and net-new clients using our audit framework, and contribute improvements to the framework over time

— Diagnose crawl, indexation, rendering, and structured data issues using Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or equivalent tools

— Develop and prioritize optimization roadmaps based on audit findings, search data, and business impact

— Review and improve site architecture, internal linking strategies, URL structures, and crawl efficiency

— Audit and implement schema markup (FAQ, LocalBusiness, Article, HowTo, etc.) across client sites

On-Page & Content Optimization Direction

— Define on-page optimization requirements for blog posts, service pages, and location pages (meta titles, descriptions, heading structure, keyword targeting, internal links)

— Create clear, actionable optimization briefs that the execution team can implement without ambiguity

— Review published content for SEO quality and flag issues before they compound

— Guide keyword targeting and content gap analysis to inform the editorial calendar

GEO / Generative Engine Optimization

— Optimize client content for visibility in AI-generated search results, featured snippets, and answer engine experiences

— Structure content to satisfy entity-based search, question-intent queries, and knowledge graph signals

— Stay current on how Google SGE, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and ChatGPT Search surface and cite content, and adapt strategies accordingly

— Implement and refine structured data to improve content eligibility for rich results and AI citations

Reporting & Founder Collaboration

— Track key SEO metrics (rankings, organic traffic, indexation, CTR, featured snippet capture) and report on progress

— Join weekly or biweekly syncs with the founder to discuss strategy, audit findings, and client priorities

— Document recurring SEO processes and build lightweight SOPs as workflows stabilize



What This Role Is Not

— Not a blog-writing or content-creation role (we have writers and an execution team for that)

— Not a general virtual assistant or admin role

— Not client-facing account management

— Not social media management or graphic design

— Not WordPress development or plugin/theme coding



Tools You Will Use

Training provided for any tools you have not used before, but you must be proficient in the core SEO toolset.



— Google Search Console (required)

— Ahrefs or SEMrush (required — Ahrefs preferred)

— WordPress with Rank Math (required)

— Google Analytics / GA4 (required)

— Screaming Frog or similar crawler (strongly preferred)

— Google Sheets / Docs / Drive (required)

— Schema markup generators or manual JSON-LD (required)

— Slack (daily communication)

— Asana (task management tool familiarity — Asana preferred)



Must-Haves

— Minimum 2 years of hands-on technical SEO experience (not just content SEO or on-page basics)

— Demonstrated ability to run a technical SEO audit end-to-end and produce actionable findings

— Strong understanding of site architecture, crawl budget, indexation, Core Web Vitals, and structured data

— Working knowledge of GEO / generative engine optimization concepts and how AI search is evolving

— Experience with schema markup implementation (JSON-LD preferred)

— Proficiency with Ahrefs or SEMrush for keyword research, backlink analysis, and site audits

— Strong WordPress experience, including Rank Math configuration

— Ability to write clear optimization briefs and technical recommendations that a non-technical executor can follow

— Strong written English — communication is critical in this role

— Available Monday–Friday with at least 3 hours of overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM

— Detail-oriented — we serve professional services clients (lawyers, healthcare) where errors are a serious problem

— Reliable internet connection with a backup plan



Nice-to-Haves (Not Required, But You Will Stand Out)

— Experience with local SEO (Google Business Profile optimization, citation building, local pack strategy)

— Familiarity with log file analysis for crawl diagnostics

— Experience managing or directing junior SEO executors

— Background in agency environments or managing SEO across multiple client accounts simultaneously

— Understanding of programmatic SEO or template-based page optimization

— Experience with Ahrefs Brand Radar or AI visibility monitoring tools

— Familiarity with NLP-driven content optimization tools (Surfer, Clearscope, Frase, or similar)



Hours & Working Style

— Starts part-time: 10–20 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time based on performance during the evaluation period

— Long-term engagement — we are building a team, not filling a one-off project

— Consistent weekly availability preferred over sporadic large blocks

— At least 3 hours daily overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–12 PM for real-time collaboration

— Clear, proactive communication matters more than total hours logged

— You will work alongside our execution VA (WordPress, publishing, formatting) and the founder (strategy, client relationships)



What We Offer

We treat contractors like tea
mbers. After a 90-day evaluation period, you become eligible for the following perks with graduation into full-time status:



— Prorated 13th Month Payment — Paid in December or at year-end close, prorated based on months actively engaged after eligibility.

— Paid Time Off — 40 hours (5 days) of PTO upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation period. After one full year of engagement, this increases to 80 hours (10 days) annually.

— Sick / Emergency Time — Reasonable notice required. Specific terms defined during onboarding.

— Remote Work Allowance — $25 to $50 USD/month to support your internet, power, and workspace costs. Exact amount confirmed in writing based on performance and continued engagement.

— Recognized Holidays — Blended Philippine and US holiday calendar agreed upon during onboarding.

— Performance Bonus — Discretionary and based on quality, reliability, output, client impact, and role-specific KPIs.

— Full-Time Conversion — Strong performers during the evaluation period will be offered a transition to full-time hours with expanded scope and responsibilities.



90-Day Evaluation Period: The first 90 days are a mutual evaluation period. During this time, we assess reliability, work quality, turnaround time, communication, attention to detail, and tool adoption. Contractor perks and full-time consideration begin after successful completion of this period.



How to Apply

Please start your proposal with the word OPTIMIZE so we know you read the full post.



In your proposal, please answer the following:



1. Describe a technical SEO issue you identified during an audit and how you resolved it.

2. What is one thing most SEOs get wrong about optimizing for AI-driven search (GEO/AEO) in 2026?

3. Are you comfortable in a role where you own strategy recommendations but the founder makes final decisions on direction?



If you have a portfolio, audit sample, or case study showing SEO results you contributed to, please include it.

title: Long-term podcast clip strategist + editor for top show (data-driven, performance incentives)
description:
I host The Grateful Podcast, a long-form interview show in the top 2.5% globally with 130+ episodes and a growing presence on YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok. Past guests include David Meltzer, Hala Taha, and Dan Millman.

I'm hiring one person long-term to own short-form clipping across the full library. The model is closer to what Steven Bartlett's team does on Diary of a CEO than a typical clip-and-post freelance gig. This is ongoing work for as long as the show runs.

The work:



New episodes drop weekly. You clip from those.

You also clip from the back catalog. A 6-month-old episode with a strong moment is a clip we haven't made yet. The full 130+ episode library is fair game.

We work from data. Together we review what's performing, identify patterns, and double down on what's working. If a clip from Episode 80 hits, we look at why and reclip in that direction.

Target volume: roughly 40 finished clips per month across platforms.

Turnaround: weekly batch delivery, schedule we agree on together.



Compensation:



Base: starting from $600-$1,000/month depending on experience. Not rock set on this can be discussed further.

***Performance incentives on top of base. 

Clips that hit defined view and engagement thresholds earn bonuses. 

We'll set the thresholds together once we have a baseline.

Paid weekly. Reliable, on-time.



The editing philosophy:

The clip is the story. The editing serves the story. Not the other way around.

What I want:



Crisp cuts. Tight pacing. Dead beats removed.

Clean branded captions, consistent placement, consistent font.

The show logo, subtle, in a fixed position.

Let the moment breathe when the moment deserves it.



What I do not want:



Flashy B-roll cutaways every few seconds.

Exuberant text effects, zoom-bounce, shake, pop animations.

Stock footage layered over the speaker.

Emoji in captions.

Sound effects, swooshes, risers, transitions that announce themselves.

Anything that looks like a TikTok template.



Look at how Diary of a CEO, Lex Fridman, and Modern Wisdom edit their short-form. Simple. Story-led. The face, the words, the captions. That is the bar.

If your portfolio is full of zoom-punch edits and stock B-roll, we're not a fit and that's okay. If your portfolio shows restraint and trust in the speaker, keep reading.

What I'm looking for:



Demonstrated experience clipping podcasts specifically. Not gaming. Not MrBeast-style. Podcasts.

Comfort reading analytics. You can look at a YouTube Studio dashboard or Instagram Insights and tell me what it means.

Strong taste for what makes a story moment land.

Clean caption work. Branded, consistent, readable.

You can articulate why a moment is a clip, not just cut what sounds good.

At least one creator you've worked with for 6 months or longer.



Open to candidates anywhere. Fit and quality first, location second.

To apply, send me:



Three podcast clips you've made for past clients. Links, not attachments.

The name of one creator you've worked with for 6+ months.

Your rate per finished clip and your monthly capacity.

Pick one podcast clip account on Instagram or TikTok whose editing style you respect. In two or three sentences, tell me what they do well and where their restraint shows.



I read every application. I do not respond to generic pitches. If you copy-paste a template, I'll see it and skip you.

Shortlisted candidates will do a paid trial: three clips from one episode, $50-$75 flat. From there, we go long.

Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Senior PPC Manager — Orellana UK
description:
We're a fast-growing, ambitious team based in the UK, managing Amazon brand growth across UK & Europe. We're ideally looking for a Senior PPC Manager to support our current success and eventually own our paid advertising operation - someone sharp, self-driven, and ready to grow into a long-term leadership role.



This is a full-time position. We're not filling a seat- we're starting to build a team of A players , and we want someone who wants to build with us.



---



Who We Are



At Orellana, our core belief is simple: every brand and product is our own.



Unlike most agencies, we don't charge retainers or % of ad spend - we grow when our brands grow. Our entire business and every relationship we build is based on delivering real value, we sell more units and therefore we are all about the shared win results for us and our clients.  We don't treat client accounts as numbers on a screen; we treat them as businesses we're genuinely responsible for. You'll know each product inside and out, not just the ad account.



That means we go deep, we care about the details, and we hold ourselves to a high standard.



We're transparent with each other and with the brands we work with. We own our mistakes, celebrate what's working, and always ask what we can do better. If you're looking for a place where your work actually matters and where you can grow into something bigger, this is it.



We believe finding the right cultural fit matters more than any perk we could offer. If our values resonate with you, we'd genuinely love to hear from you.



---



What You'll Do:



- Own and optimise Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns across multiple brands and accounts

- Monitor and act on key metrics - TACoS, ACoS, Organic Sales %, CVR, and more - to continuously improve performance

- Design and test bidding strategies, keyword targeting approaches, and campaign structures

- Identify waste, find opportunities, and make data-backed decisions quickly

- Own the advertising P&L for your accounts - understanding how ad spend decisions flow through to contribution margin and overall brand profitability, not just ACOS

- Produce weekly and monthly reports with real insights, clear recommendations, and current strategy - not just exported dashboards

- Work closely with the team on product launches, listing optimisation, and brand strategy

- Use AI tools (including Claude) actively in your workflow - from analysis and reporting to building smarter internal processes - and help shape how the team adopts new tools and ways of working

- Stay current on Amazon advertising trends and bring proactive ideas to the table

-Operate with our systems and internal software



---



What We're Looking For



- 2+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns — not oversight, but in the accounts daily

- Experience managing at least £20k/month in ad spend across Amazon UK & EU marketplaces

- Strong analytical skills and a genuine problem-solving mindset

- Ability to work independently and take full ownership — reliable internet, a professional remote setup, and at least 4 hours of daily overlap with UK working hours

- Honest, accountable, and direct - you flag issues early and own your results

- Growth-oriented: always learning, always asking how to do it better

- Excellent written English communication skills

- Daily working experience with Datadive and Scale Insights

- Comfortable using AI tools, including Claude, as part of your day-to-day workflow - and open to adopting new internal systems and processes as we evolve

-Willingness to learn systems and sops



Nice to have: Experience across EU marketplaces in multiple languages - German and French are key new markets for us.



We are really looking for someone who wants to build a long term career and cares about the entire business growth not just the accounts they manage. You will be our first key and senior hire. We have been working with brands for 5 years now and have delivered some good results, we now want to scale this and grow the business.



---



How to Apply



A few things to keep our process efficient:



- Start your message with JUNGLE to confirm you've read this post in full.

- If you used AI tools to help write your application, include "AI" at the end of your message - no judgement, just transparency.

- We're looking for an individual freelancer. Applications from agencies will not be considered.



Tell us about a campaign result you're proud of and why. We read every application. 



Bonus: Share a real example of how you use AI or automation in your PPC workflows to improve speed, analysis, reporting, or decision-making.



We'll be in touch with next steps :)

title: Amazon VA - Executive Assistant
description:
Amazon SEO Monitoring VA — Clean + Kind

Reports to: Patrick, Co-Founder Hours: ~5 hrs/week baseline, ~10 hrs on checkpoint weeks Schedule: Monday mornings, fixed cadence Pay: [TBD] · hourly or per-week flat rate Location: Remote · timezone flexible



The role

Pull a small, fixed set of Amazon reports every Monday. Compare them to a baseline. Flag anything that's off. Send a short weekly summary. Once a quarter, help with a deeper re-audit.

This is a monitoring role, not a strategy role. The system is already built — a dashboard with twelve-week checkpoints, a competitor set held constant, and a documented rhythm. Your job is to run that rhythm reliably and surface signal.



What you'll do each Monday

 1 Pull the Business Report (Detail Page Sales and Traffic by Child ASIN, 7-day window) from Seller Central. ~5 minutes.

 2 Capture the product page snapshot — BSR, review count, price — from Amazon.com for each tracked ASIN. ~2 minutes per product.

 3 Log the numbers into the tracking spreadsheet against the baseline.

 4 Send a short summary by 11 AM Monday: what moved, what didn't, anything that crossed a threshold flagged in red.

On checkpoint weeks (every 2-4 weeks)

 5 Pull Cerebro keyword exports from Helium 10 — same eight competitors every time, the set is saved.

 6 Run the indexing check at Day 7 — sixteen incognito Amazon searches per product, log pass/fail.

 7 Compile the checkpoint summary against the targets in the dashboard.

Once a quarter

 8 Support the Day 60 full re-audit — pull extended-window reports, prep the deliverable folder, organize raw data so Patrick can run the analysis.



Required

 • Solid English, written. The weekly summary is the deliverable — clarity matters more than length.

 • Comfortable inside Seller Central and Helium 10. If you've never used either, this isn't the role.

 • Excel or Google Sheets fluent — you'll be filling templated tracking sheets, not building them.

 • Reliable on a fixed schedule. Late Monday reports break the whole system.

 • Attention to detail. Misreading a BSR number or pulling the wrong date range creates downstream noise that's hard to fix.

Nice to have

 • Prior Amazon FBA / private label experience

 • Familiarity with PPC reports (Sponsored Products, basic ACoS reading)

 • Comfort with markdown / structured note formats

Not required

 • SEO strategy — Patrick handles that

 • Copywriting — the listings are already written

 • Image work — not part of this role



How we'll measure you in the first 90 days

 • Reports pulled on time, every week — Monday before 11 AM, zero misses

 • Data accuracy — numbers logged match the source reports

 • Threshold flagging — when something drops below the baseline alert level, it's surfaced same-day, not buried

 • Tidy file organization — every export saved with the documented naming convention

Call, SMS, and
 new Meta Ads leads within 5 minutes of submission

Qualify each lead using set scripts: project type, timeline, budget, decision-maker, homeowner status

Book confirmed appointments on the sales rep's calendar in GoHighLevel

Re-engage all leads who didn't answer during the AM shift — evenings are when they pick up

Log every touchpoint in GHL with detailed notes

Tag and segment leads by project type, stage, and source

Send a daily end-of-shift report: leads worked, contacts made, appointments set, show rate

Flag junk or fraudulent leads back to the ads team

Confirm next-day appointments with homeowners

Coordinate any same-day reschedules with field sales reps





Hard Requirements (Do Not Apply Without These)



Minimum 1 year appointment setting, inside sales, or lead generation for a US-based company

Have spoken on the phone with US customers — chat-only and
-only experience does not qualify

Hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, workflows, SMS/email automations, calendars, tags, custom fields

Neutral, clear English. Confident phone presence. No heavy accent.

25+ Mbps wired internet, backup internet connection (mobile hotspot acceptable), noise-canceling headset, UPS or backup power, quiet dedicated workspace with door

Available 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM PHT every Monday through Saturday, on time

Cannot be working another full-time job simultaneously



Bonus Points



Home improvement, contractor, roofing, solar, HVAC, windows, kitchen/bath, or remodeling experience

Built GoHighLevel workflows and snapshots from scratch

Handled Meta/Facebook ad leads before — you know they're mostly tire-kickers and you still convert

Familiar with US homeowner objections and soft-sales techniques





Compensation Structure

Base salary:



Months 1–3: $400 USD/month

Month 4 onward (after passing 90-day trial): $500 USD/month

Paid weekly every Friday in USD via Wise or PayPal



Performance bonuses (paid monthly):



$4 USD per qualified appointment set (booked + confirmed on rep's calendar)

$6 USD per appointment that shows (homeowner sits with sales rep)

$35 USD per appointment that closes into a signed contract



Additional benefits:



13th month pay (one additional half-month of base, paid December 15)

5 paid days off per year after 90-day trial period

$75 one-time equipment stipend after passing 30-day trial

Base salary reviewed annually after the 90-day bump

Performance-based raises up to 15% per review



Realistic earning potential (after 90 days):



Average performer: ~$1,100/month

Top performer: ~$1,500/month



PM shift earns more in bonuses due to higher evening conversion rates.

Clawback clause: Invalid appointments (wrong number, not homeowner, no-show without confirmation, under-budget) reverse the bonus in the next pay cycle. Full definition of "qualified appointment" is in the offer letter.

Status: Independent contractor. You handle your own BIR taxes. Annual earnings statement provided.



Success Metrics You Will Be Measured On



Speed to lead: Average response time under 5 minutes

Set rate: % of leads converted to scheduled appointments

Show rate: % of set appointments that result in a completed sales visit

CRM accuracy: Completeness and timeliness of GHL updates

Follow-up consistency: Adherence to follow-up sequences





Hiring Process



Application screening (24–48 hours)

30-minute Zoom interview with camera, screen-share, and live GHL walkthrough

Paid practical test (~2–4 hours, paid at full rate): mock calls, GHL build task, written communication test

Reference check with prior US employers

30-day paid trial period with daily check-ins first week, weekly call reviews, and hard performance metrics

90-day base salary bump from $400 to $500 upon successful trial completion





To Apply — Read Carefully. Incomplete Applications Are Rejected.

Submit ALL of the following:



A 60-second Loom or video selfie introducing yourself, explaining why you fit this role, and listing the specific GoHighLevel features you have hands-on experience with. Written intros will be rejected.

A 1-minute audio recording of you role-playing this exact scenario: "You are calling Mary, a homeowner who submitted a
 lead form 4 minutes ago requesting information about bathroom remodeling. Open the call, qualify her, and attempt to book an in-home estimate."

Your resume.

The names of 2 US-based companies you have appointment-set for, including your direct supervisor's name and contact (we will verify).

Answer in writing:



What was your lead-to-appointment conversion rate in your last role, and how did you measure it?

What was your average daily call volume and connect rate?

Describe one GoHighLevel workflow you built end-to-end. What triggered it, what actions fired, what was the goal?

Confirm: can you commit to 6:00 AM – 11:00 AM PHT, Monday through Saturday, for at least 12 months?





Type the word "FALCON" at the very top of your application.



Applications missing any of these 6 items will not be reviewed.

title: Luxury Event Concierge Specialist
description:
We are a luxury event-planning company based in Los Angeles, specializing in premium picnics, proposals, birthdays, baby showers, bridal showers, tablescapes, and private celebrations.



We are looking for a reliable, polished, and highly detail-oriented Luxury Event Concierge Specialist to support client communication, lead follow-ups, reservations, payments, and event coordination.



This is a client-facing luxury concierge role, not a basic Virtual Assistant position. We need someone who can communicate professionally with US clients, guide leads through the booking process, handle pricing conversations, notice missing details, and take ownership without repeated reminders.



The right person is calm, organized, proactive, and comfortable helping clients move from first inquiry to confirmed booking.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with the opportunity to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Work Hours



Our main business hours are 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM PT / California time.



The exact schedule will be discussed during the hiring process, but we are looking for someone who can commit to a consistent part-time schedule of approximately 4 hours per day, 5 days per week.



What This Role Really Means



You will help protect the client experience from inquiry to event day.



You will be responsible for making sure leads are followed up with, clients receive clear answers, reservations are organized, payments are tracked, and missing details are noticed before they become problems.



This role requires someone who can think ahead, communicate clearly, and help keep the business organized every day.



Responsibilities

- Respond to client inquiries by
, phone, text, and messages

- Handle client calls professionally and confidently

- Follow up with leads and help convert inquiries into bookings

- Guide clients through packages, pricing, availability, and booking steps

- Handle pricing questions and objections in a polished, professional way

- Add new reservations and update client records

- Track payments, balances, event details, and client notes

- Review upcoming events for missing details, timing issues, or unclear requests

- Prepare client messages, summaries, and internal updates

- Support event planners with organized reservation information

- Help create and update event checklists when needed

- Use tools such as Gmail, Google Sheets, Asana, Stripe, and ChatGPT

- Escalate urgent or unclear situations before they become problems

- Help maintain a luxury-level client experience from inquiry to event day



Must-Have Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confident speaking with US clients by phone

- Experience in customer success, sales, hospitality, events, weddings, travel, concierge service, or premium customer service

- Strong follow-up skills and comfort helping turn inquiries into bookings

- Ability to handle pricing questions professionally

- Very strong attention to detail with dates, times, payments, client requests, and event notes

- Reliable, proactive, and able to complete work without repeated reminders

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, admin work, and structured processes

- Fast internet, quiet workspace, and professional communication style

- Backup plan for internet or power issues, such as hotspot, mobile access, or another reliable work location

- Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT to improve drafts, summaries, and templates



Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate has experience supporting premium clients and understands that tone, timing, accuracy, and follow-up matter.



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Can write polished and natural client messages

- Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support

- Can organize details without constant supervision

- Notice missing information before it creates a problem

- Know when to answer directly and when to escalate

- Stay calm and professional under pressure

- Want a long-term role with growth potential



Please Do Not Apply If

- You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only

- You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone

- You need repeated reminders to complete tasks

- You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests

- You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations

- You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task

- You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues



Compensation

Starting at $6–$8/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background.



This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person.



Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership.



We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role.



To Apply



Please answer all questions below. Applications without complete answers will not be reviewed.



1. What experience do you have with luxury clients, events, hospitality, weddings, travel, concierge service, sales, or premium customer service?

2. Describe a time when you helped close a client, saved a client relationship, or handled a difficult customer professionally.

3. Have you handled phone calls with US clients? Please describe the type of calls and your comfort level.

4. A client says: “Your picnic is too expensive. Other companies are cheaper.” Write your professional reply.

5. A client asks for a proposal picnic quote but does not respond after receiving pricing. Write your follow-up message.

6. You are reviewing tomorrow’s events and notice that one client has not paid the remaining balance and the final location is not confirmed. What would you do?

7. Your power or internet goes out during your shift. What is your backup plan and how would you notify the team?

8. Are you available during 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM California time? Please share your preferred schedule and confirm if you are open to Tuesday–Saturday availability.

9. In the first line of your application, write: “I understand this is a client-facing luxury event concierge role.”



Please attach your most recent resume/CV. Thank you.

title: Video Editor
description:
Meta Ads Video Editor Wanted – E-Commerce | Long-Term Role

We run e-commerce brands across 4 international markets and we're scaling our paid social aggressively. We're looking for a high-output video editor to start with 2 of our markets — with a clear path to expand to all 4 markets (and higher pay) once you've proven your speed and quality.



Weekly Output Breakdown (Phase 1):



- 30–40 ads per week per market

- 2 markets to start

- Total: 60–80 ads per week (~260–340 ads/month)



Speed, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of what makes ads convert matter more than fancy VFX. This is a performance creative role, not a cinematic one.



The Opportunity



- Phase 1 (months 1–2): 30–40 ads/week per market × 2 markets = 60–80 ads/week total

- Phase 2 (month 3+): If you're crushing it, we expand to all 4 markets = 120–160 ads/week total with a meaningful pay raise

- Long-term: A stable, well-paid seat on a growing team — not a one-off gig



What You'll Be Doing



- Editing 30–40 Meta ads per week per market (60–80 ads/week total across 2 markets)

- Producing the same ad concept in 2 languages

- Swapping text overlays, captions, subtitles, and voiceovers for each language version

- Producing multiple variations per concept (different hooks, CTAs, intros, durations)

- Cutting UGC footage, stock clips, product shots, and screen recordings into scroll-stopping ads

- Formats: 9:16 (Reels/Stories), 1:1 (Feed), 4:5

- Adding captions, B-roll, text overlays, sound effects, music, and pattern interrupts

- Editing in the style of proven ad frameworks: Problem/Solution, Testimonial, Listicle, Before/After, Founder Story, Unboxing, "Did You Know", etc.

- Building reusable templates for efficient localization

- Organizing files by market/language so we can track performance per region

- Iterating fast based on ad performance feedback



Must-Haves



- 2+ years editing Meta/Facebook ads specifically (not just YouTube or weddings — paid social is its own craft)

- Proficient in at least one of: DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, Premiere Pro

- Proven capacity to deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market consistently

- Experience producing ads in multiple languages — you understand how text timing, line breaks, and subtitle pacing change when text length differs between languages

- Comfortable working with provided translations and voiceover files (we supply them — you don't need to speak the languages)

- Master of template-based workflows — you don't rebuild from scratch for every language version

- Extreme attention to detail with foreign-language text — no typos, no cut-off captions, no mismatched timing, even in languages you don't speak

- Deep understanding of the first 3 seconds — you know a weak hook when you see one

- Good English (written communication with our team)

- Reliable internet and a computer that handles HD editing smoothly



What We Offer



- Competitive monthly salary for Phase 1 (60–80 ads/week, 2 markets)

- Clear raise if/when we expand you to all 4 markets (120–160 ads/week)

- Performance reviews and raises every 6 months

- A clear brief for every ad with all assets (footage, translations, voiceovers) organized and ready

- Long-term, stable work — we're scaling, not testing the waters



How to Apply

To prove you actually read this (most applicants don't), please do the following:



1. Start your application with the word "Scroll-Stop" — applications without this will be ignored.

2. Send 3–5 examples of Meta ads you personally edited (Drive, YouTube, or Meta Ads Library links).

3. Have you produced ads in multiple languages before? If yes, which languages and how did you handle the workflow?

4. Be honest: can you realistically deliver 30–40 high-quality ads/week per market (60–80 total across 2 markets)? If your max is lower, tell me your actual sustainable number.

5. Tell me in 2–3 sentences: what makes a Meta ad hook work in the first 3 seconds?

6. Share your monthly rate and your main editing software.

7. Bonus: link to one e-commerce brand whose Meta ads you admire — and why.



Top candidates will get a paid test project (1 concept localized into 2 languages) within a week. The right person gets a long-term home with us.
